title: Higher Ext vanishes for coherent sheaves on a regular curve
statement: Let $X$ be a regular [def-weil-regular-scheme] Noetherian scheme (quasi-compact [def-weil-pbc-quasi-compact-scheme] and locally Noetherian [pqf-def-locnoeth]) of finite dimension $d$ [def-pc-dimension] and let $\mathcal F,\mathcal G$ be coherent $\mathcal O_X$-modules [pqf-def-coherent], with Ext as in [def-sc-ext-sheaf]. Then $\operatorname{Ext}^i_X(\mathcal F,\mathcal G)=0$ for every $i>d$. In particular, for $X=\mathbf P^1_k$ [def-sc-p1-standard] with $k$ a field one has $\operatorname{Ext}^i_X(\mathcal F,\mathcal G)=0$ for all $i\ge2$.

proof.text: By [lem-sc-ext-sheaf-to-global-spectral-sequence] there is a spectral sequence with $E_2^{p,q}=H^p(X,\mathcal Ext^q_{\mathcal O_X}(\mathcal F,\mathcal G))$, zero unless $p,q\geq0$, abutting to $\operatorname{Ext}^{p+q}_X(\mathcal F,\mathcal G)$.

source.place: Lemma lemma-Ext-0-regular (Tag 0FZ3), proof of (1), first paragraph

proof.text: Let $x\in X$ and $d_x=\dim\mathcal O_{X,x}$; then $d_x\leq d$ by the definition of $\dim X$. By [lem-sc-ext-stalk-localization], $\mathcal Ext^q_{\mathcal O_X}(\mathcal F,\mathcal G)_x\cong\operatorname{Ext}^q_{\mathcal O_{X,x}}(\mathcal F_x,\mathcal G_x)$. Since $X$ is regular, $\mathcal O_{X,x}$ is a regular local ring, and $\mathcal F_x$ is a finitely generated $\mathcal O_{X,x}$-module because $\mathcal F$ is coherent; so [lem-sc-regular-local-ext-vanishing] makes this stalk zero for $q>d_x$. (This is the stalkwise vanishing behind the support bound of the next step.)

source.place: Lemma lemma-Ext-0-regular (Tag 0FZ3), proof of (1), local calculation

proof.text: By [lem-sc-ext-support-cohomology-vanishing], $H^p(X,\mathcal Ext^q_{\mathcal O_X}(\mathcal F,\mathcal G))=0$ whenever $p>d-q$, that is, $E_2^{p,q}=0$ whenever $p+q>d$.

source.place: Lemma lemma-Ext-0-regular (Tag 0FZ3), proof of (1), final paragraph

proof.text: All $E_2$ terms of total degree $p+q>d$ vanish by Step 3, so the last assertion of [lem-sc-ext-sheaf-to-global-spectral-sequence] gives $\operatorname{Ext}^n_X(\mathcal F,\mathcal G)=0$ for every $n>d$.

For $X=\mathbf P^1_k$, [lem-sc-p1-regular-dimension-one] says that $X$ is a regular Noetherian scheme of dimension $d=1$, so the general assertion gives $\operatorname{Ext}^i_X(\mathcal F,\mathcal G)=0$ for every $i>1$, i.e. every $i\geq2$.
